walkthroughs.body_html:
A top essay starts with a thesis — your overall argument.

Example: Shakespeare presents Macbeth as a warning that unchecked ambition destroys both man and state.

Context isn't a paragraph at the end — it should sit inside your analysis.

Macbeth was written for James I, who believed in the Divine Right of kings. Killing a king (regicide) was the ultimate Jacobean sin.

Top essays offer alternative readings: feminist, Marxist, psychoanalytic.

Is Lady Macbeth a villain — or a woman trapped in a patriarchal society who unleashes ambition the only way she can?

mcqs.q: What is the dramatic function of a soliloquy?
options: It reveals a character's inner thoughts directly to the audience while the character is alone on stage — a convention granting access to private psychology.
A soliloquy is when characters argue with each other.
A sonnet must always be exactly ten lines long.
A soliloquy is any long speech a character gives.
Iambic pentameter is any line with ten syllables.
A line of five iambs (unstressed-stressed syllable pairs), creating a ten-syllable line with the rhythm da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM.
Iambic pentameter is when every line rhymes.
A sonnet must always be exactly ten lines long.

mcqs.q: What is the structure of a Shakespearean sonnet?
options: A sonnet must always be exactly ten lines long.
Fourteen lines in iambic pentameter, structured as three quatrains and a final couplet, rhyming ABAB CDCD EFEF GG, often with a volta near the couplet.
A sonnet is any short love poem.
Iambic pentameter is when every line rhymes.
